stem:
Yamini wants a 3-digit number whose digits add to 9.

Which number has digit sum 9?

options.text: 900, reading only the leading digit 9 as the digit sum.
123, because 123 looks like the smallest neat 3-digit print.
306, because 306 is greater than all its neighbouring cells in a grid.

teacher.key_rationale: Digit sum adds every digit: 3 + 0 + 6 = 9. Taking only one digit, choosing by surface appearance, or using a supercell comparison all miss summing the digits.
